scope: NoteManager.ExecUpdate per-substep Note update and After-update scheduling
per_substep_order: advance InGameMusicScoreController by the divided delta time
iterate activeNoteList in reverse order and call NoteBase.ExecuteUpdate
after each ExecuteUpdate, append the Note to refExecuteNotes only when get_IsStateDeactive returns false
iterate refExecuteNotes in append order and dispatch virtual ExecuteAfterUpdate

after_update_dispatch.proof: NoteBase_VTable and NoteAddSlideMultipleDirectionalFlickVisual_VTable both name slot 14 ExecuteAfterUpdate; Il2CppClass vtable base plus fourteen 16-byte VirtualInvokeData entries yields the observed +0x218 method pointer

multiple_direction_back_line_order: the terminal After does not override ExecuteAfterUpdate; its inherited slot 14 has no back-line call
NoteSlideMultipleDirectionalFlickAfter.MoveState checks backLine +0x200 and tail-branches to OnUpdate at 0x32230C8 during that terminal Note's ExecuteUpdate
the same override then tail-calls NoteMultipleDirectionalFlickBackLine.OnUpdate at 0x30E8574 when its line reference is non-null

visual-owned lines therefore observe every Note mutation completed before the After phase, while terminal-owned lines observe only mutations completed before the terminal's reverse-order ExecuteUpdate position

timing_correction.previous_model: all multiple-direction lines were advanced together in the batched After phase
timing_correction.confirmed_model: terminal-owned lines advance inline in terminal MoveState during ExecuteUpdate; visual-owned lines advance from the visual ExecuteAfterUpdate override after the full Update traversal
timing_correction.consequence: a terminal bridge can mechanically deactivate in the same substep when its target changed earlier in reverse active-list order, but guarded group activation makes a side target's own Update occur after the terminal; the reachable same-Update route is terminal-owned side consumption
